examples.sentence: 应聘时，首先要穿正式的衣服，其次不要紧张。
examples.romanization: yìngpìn shí， shǒuxiān yào chuān zhèngshì de yīfu， qícì bùyào jǐnzhāng。
examples.translation: At the job interview, first [you] should wear formal clothing, and second don't be nervous.

examples.sentence: 不管什么电影，我都喜欢看。
examples.romanization: bùguǎn shénme diànyǐng， wǒ dōu xǐhuan kàn。
examples.translation: I like to watch all kinds of movies. (Lit. No matter what movie, I like to watch them all.)

examples.sentence: 我以为东西是给我的，其实是给爸爸的。
examples.romanization: wǒ yǐwéi dōngxi shì gěi wǒ de， qíshí shì gěi bàba de。
examples.translation: I thought the thing was for me, but actually it was for my father.

title: 原来 clause (it turns out)
longExplanation: it turns out. Pinyin: yuánlái clause

examples.sentence: 我还以为是谁帮我打扫房间呢，原来是你啊！
examples.romanization: wǒ hái yǐwéi shì shéi bāng wǒ dǎsǎo fángjiān ne， yuánlái shì nǐ ā！
examples.translation: I was wondering who was cleaning the room for me. It turns out it’s you!

title: 并不/并没 V/A ((emphasize the negative))
longExplanation: (emphasize the negative). Pinyin: bìngbù/ bìng méi V/A

examples.sentence: 大家说外面很冷，但我并不觉得冷。
examples.romanization: dàjiā shuō wàimiàn hěn lěng， dàn wǒ bìngbù juéde lěng。
examples.translation: Everyone said that it was cold outside, but I (rather) didn’t feel cold.

title: 按照 N (according to N)
longExplanation: according to N. Pinyin: ànzhào N

examples.sentence: 我们还是按照原来的计划进行。
examples.romanization: wǒmen háishi ànzhào yuánlái de jìhuà jìnxíng。
examples.translation: We are still proceeding according to the original plan.

examples.sentence: 他工作很努力，甚至忘了吃饭。
examples.romanization: tā gōngzuò hěn nǔlì， shènzhì wàng le chīfàn。
examples.translation: He worked hard and even forgot to eat.

examples.sentence: 运动对身体健康肯定有好处。
examples.romanization: yùndòng duì shēntǐ jiànkāng kěndìng yǒu hǎochu。
examples.translation: Exercise is definitely good for your health.

examples.sentence: 我能肯定，张远一定会来。
examples.romanization: wǒ néng kěndìng， zhāng yuǎn yīdìng huì lái。
examples.translation: I can be sure that Zhang Yuan will definitely come.

examples.romanization: tā de huídá shì kěndìng de。
examples.translation: His answer is yes (in the affirmative).

title: 再说 (talk about it / deal with it until a later time)
shortExplanation: talk about it / deal with it until a later time
longExplanation: talk about it / deal with it until a later time. Pinyin: zàishuō

examples.sentence: 现在学习忙，考完再说吧。
examples.romanization: xiànzài xuéxí máng， kǎowán zàishuō ba。
examples.translation: I’m busy studying now, let’s talk about it / deal with it (until) after the exam.

examples.sentence: 毕业后大家都很忙，再说，很多同学不在一个城市。
examples.romanization: bìyè hòu dàjiā dōu hěn máng， zàishuō， hěn duō tóngxué bùzài yī gè chéngshì。
examples.translation: After graduation, everyone was very busy. Besides, many students are not in a city.

examples.sentence: 实际的东西跟广告上的不一样。
examples.romanization: shíjì de dōngxi gēn guǎnggào shàng de bùyīyàng。
examples.translation: The actual thing is different from the one on the advertisement.
